bench_aligners_xxl_hifi_relative.title: XXL_HIFI report_76 relative-performance gate
bench_aligners_xxl_hifi_relative.description: XXL_HIFI-only non-E2E algorithm comparison. Four samples and nine controlled rows preserve report_76's within-run P50 wall/stage relationships without requiring historical absolute wall times. Every Vulkan-labelled row is a historical partial-GPU probe (CPU work remains) and is explicitly ineligible for all-GPU acceptance.

test_case_descriptions.SHORT_HIFI: 300 bp fragments, ~0.2% HiFi-style error, 3 kbp reference
test_case_descriptions.MEDIUM_HIFI: 5 kbp fragments, ~0.2% HiFi-style error, 30 kbp reference
test_case_descriptions.LONG_HIFI: 50 kbp fragments, ~0.2% HiFi error, 250 kbp reference
test_case_descriptions.XXL_HIFI: Single-group 0.5 Gbp reference to 5 Mbp fragment, ~0.2% HiFi error; serial grouping leaves admission headroom for the Vulkan query sketch nested under the segmented target-wave permit
test_case_descriptions.XXL_HIFI_PAIRED: Single-group copy of XXL_HIFI for 11-repeat paired serial acceptance; identical generated workload and seed
test_case_descriptions.RMQ_REPRO_LONG_CCS: Pinned (LONG, CCS) seed that previously segfaulted on bioseq-RMQ chaining
test_case_descriptions.CURATED_UNIQUE_FRAGMENT: Single error-free fragment from a 2 kbp random reference — trivial alignment
test_case_descriptions.CURATED_SEAL_BATCH: SEAL-style 8-fragment batch with mild error and reverse-complement
test_case_descriptions.GROUPED32_LOCAL32_ONE_70K: One long 70k-word scatter-false span; primary contiguous-throughput case
test_case_descriptions.GROUPED32_LOCAL32_256_X_256: 256 medium controls with 256 contiguous local32 words each
test_case_descriptions.GROUPED32_LOCAL32_4096_X_16: 4096 short controls; exposes the SIMD cutoff and per-span reduction cost
test_case_descriptions.GROUPED32_LOCAL32_65536_X_1: Singleton negative control; vector candidates should naturally remain on scalar boundaries
test_case_descriptions.GROUPED32_LOCAL32_ZIPF_64K: Deterministic skewed control lengths summing to 65536 local32 words
